targets.rawSql: SELECT p.value_num AS "value" FROM parameters p JOIN packets pk ON p.packet_id = pk.id WHERE pk.ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND pk.ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz AND p.name = 'power_conv_chip_temp_c' ORDER BY pk.ts DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.value_num AS "value" FROM parameters p JOIN packets pk ON p.packet_id = pk.id WHERE pk.ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND pk.ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz AND p.name = 'ltm8051_temp_c' ORDER BY pk.ts DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.value_num AS "value" FROM parameters p JOIN packets pk ON p.packet_id = pk.id WHERE pk.ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND pk.ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz AND p.name = 'ddr_memory_temp_c' ORDER BY pk.ts DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT pk.ts AS "time", p.name AS "metric", p.value_num AS "value" FROM parameters p JOIN packets pk ON p.packet_id = pk.id WHERE pk.ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND pk.ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz AND p.name IN ('power_conv_chip_temp_c', 'ltm8051_temp_c', 'ddr_memory_temp_c', 'm2s090_temp_c') ORDER BY pk.ts ASC;

SELECT pk.ts AS "time", p.name AS "metric", p.value_num AS "value" FROM parameters p JOIN packets pk ON p.packet_id = pk.id WHERE pk.ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND pk.ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz AND p.name IN ('ntc_primary_ch1_c', 'ntc_primary_ch2_c', 'ntc_primary_ch3_c', 'ntc_primary_ch4_c', 'ntc_primary_ch5_c', 'ntc_primary_ch6_c', 'ntc_primary_ch7_c') ORDER BY pk.ts ASC;

SELECT pk.ts AS "time", p.name AS "metric", p.value_num AS "value" FROM parameters p JOIN packets pk ON p.packet_id = pk.id WHERE pk.ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND pk.ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz AND p.name IN ('mcu_primary_current_a', 'mcu_backup_current_a', 'ai_module_current_a') ORDER BY pk.ts ASC;

WITH heater_data AS (SELECT pk.ts AS "time", p.name AS "metric", p.value_num AS "value", LAG(p.value_num) OVER (PARTITION BY p.name ORDER BY pk.ts) as prev_val FROM parameters p JOIN packets pk ON p.packet_id = pk.id WHERE pk.ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND pk.ts <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz AND p.name IN ('prim_heater_ch1_status.pwm', 'prim_heater_ch2_status.pwm', 'prim_heater_ch3_status.pwm') ) SELECT "time", "metric", "value" FROM heater_data WHERE prev_val IS NULL OR "value" != prev_val ORDER BY "time" ASC;
